framework: local four-derivative Stelle gravity with ordinary Feynman quantization of the massive spin-2 pole
declared_domain: perturbative local four-derivative gravity in the regime where the additional massive spin-2 propagator pole is part of the ordinary asymptotic/Feynman state-space interpretation

observable.quantity: sign of the massive spin-2 pole residue / positive-metric physical-state condition

positive_control: four-derivative gravity is perturbatively renormalizable in the classic Stelle construction
negative_control: the extra massive spin-2 pole has the wrong-sign residue under ordinary Feynman/positive-metric interpretation
scope_guard: This FAIL applies only to the ordinary Feynman/Stelle pole prescription. Fakeon/purely-virtual and other contour prescriptions are materially distinct and must be tested separately.
primary_authorities: K. S. Stelle, Phys. Rev. D 16 (1977) 953
D. Anselmi & M. Piva, JHEP 05 (2018) 027, arXiv:1803.07777
